scopes.reason: Both pop callers require a nonnegative stack top: bracket analysis checks top>=0; pop_openers receives actual nonnegative opener indices and loops only while top>=opener. Every pop therefore sees top>=0.

Only emphasis and tilde analysis call md_opener_stack. Emphasis stacks contain only their star/underscore family; tilde dispatch supplies ch126. The bracket-stack fallback14 remains for source fidelity but has no actual caller.

Every resolved ordinary link/image is created by the attr-success arm, which assigns title.pointer=attr.title. Every real attr producer supplies Uint8Array, including the empty title. Wiki links bypass this path. Native pointer/null representation is not asserted; the local guarded fallback is retained.
The only text-type assignments in this function produce NORMAL, CODE, HTML or LATEXMATH. CODE/LATEXMATH and HTML are handled in preceding arms, so the remaining branch necessarily has NORMAL.

Analysis assigns dense container records at every entered depth and preserves the array when leaving. Balanced emitted list/quote events replay at depth no larger than the analysis peak, so the slot is defined. No callback exposes the parser context.
The same dense retained container/queue invariant applies independently to quote openers.

For block.data0, CODE is indented code; fenced opening sets data1. Empty lines cannot start indented code: blank classification precedes code classification, and only an existing same-container indented pivot can retain code type on a blank. Container entry/sibling transitions reset the pivot; forced new blocks are only fences/HTML. Therefore the first stored indented-code line is nonempty and this leading-trim advance cannot run. Retain the while guard and body.

Every actual md_emit_text caller supplies a positive guarded slice or nonempty SPACE/LF/NUL/SPACES constant. Escape/entity marks have nonzero validated extents; indentation chunks are guarded >0 after draining full space blocks; normal/HTML/code slices are guarded by increasing offsets; null replacement calls only for offset>0 or one NUL. The stable borrowed-input contract excludes detaching/mutating parser-owned storage during callbacks.
